summary: The requested URL normalization is implemented on the link-creation path, the prior default-port/query-offset bug is fixed, and the supplied tests and documentation cover the behavior.
rationale: LinkService.CreateAsync calls NormalizeUrl before passing the destination to the creation repository. NormalizeUrl now finds the query marker in the assembled normalized URL, avoiding the earlier offset problem when removing a default port. Unit and API integration tests cover the normalization behaviors, including persisted destinations; the docs describe the behavior and its limitations. The supplied current host evidence reports a successful build and 106 passing tests; this review did not run them.
content:
## Requirement coverage

| Requirement | Code | Tests | Assessment |
|---|---|---|---|
| Lowercase the scheme and host | `LinkService.NormalizeUrl` lowercases the scheme prefix and parsed host. It is called by `CreateAsync` before `TryCreateAsync` saves a new link. | `LinkUrlNormalizationTests.CreateAsyncStoresNormalizedDestination` and `LinkUrlNormalizationApiTests.CreateReturnsAndUsesNormalizedDestination` cover mixed-case schemes and hosts. | Met. |
| Remove default ports | `NormalizeUrl` selects port 80 for HTTP or 443 for HTTPS and removes a matching explicit port while retaining other ports. | Unit and API tests cover HTTP 80, HTTPS 443, and retention of a non-default port. `LinkUrlNormalizationRegressionApiTests.DefaultPortRemovalDoesNotPreventTrackingParameterRemoval` also checks the combined default-port and tracking-parameter case. | Met. |
| Strip `utm_` tracking parameters before saving | `NormalizeUrl` splits the query on `&`, matches each raw parameter name case-insensitively, and removes names beginning with `utm_`. `CreateAsync` passes the normalized URL—not the request URL—to the creation repository. | Unit and API tests cover case-insensitive removal, retention of similarly named non-UTM parameters and other query text, and removal when all parameters are UTM. Regression integration tests check the combined default-port case and assert the stored database destination, details response, and redirect destination. | Met. |
| Preserve the fix for query-offset changes caused by removing a default port | The query marker is located in `normalized`, after scheme, host, and port normalization. | `LinkUrlNormalizationRegressionApiTests` covers HTTP and HTTPS default-port cases with tracking parameters, including fragment/query preservation, and verifies persistence. | Prior finding fixed and covered. |

## Docs and risks

`docs/features/destination-url-handling.md` now documents when normalization occurs, the scheme/host and port rules, UTM matching behavior, persistence and redirect behavior, and limitations. Its description agrees with the implementation. The raw-name matching and `&`-based query handling are explicit limitations, not undocumented deviations from the stated requirement.

No remaining requirement gap found. The supplied current build/test evidence is successful; no build or test was run as part of this review.

Verdict: PASS
